description: US Consolidated Screening List: twelve US export-screening lists. KeyVex republishes the lists; it is not a screening service. Synced twice daily from trade.gov, which can lag the agencies by hours. source_short: SDN (OFAC), EL Entity List, DPL Denied Persons, MEU Military End User, UVL Unverified (BIS), CMIC, CAP, MBS, PLC, SSI (Treasury), DTC ITAR Debarred, ISN Nonproliferation (State). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_screening_list

country.description: ISO-2 code; 'UK', 'Turkiye', 'PRC', 'DPRK' accepted. An unrecognised code is rejected.
